# OnionSetu

> AI-assisted onion quality assessment and procurement grading for APMC and NAFED centers in Maharashtra, India.

## Description
OnionSetu captures multi-view onion samples with a 25mm reference, runs image quality checks, detects and sizes onions, classifies visible defects (Healthy / Damaged / Rotten / Sprouted), applies a versioned grading policy to compute Grade A / URS, and generates tamper-evident SHA-256 + QR reports. Offline-first, human-in-the-loop.

- Sitemap: https://onion-setu.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Policy
Current procurement policy v2026.1: size band 35–70mm, tolerances rotten ≤2%, sprouted ≤3%, damaged ≤5%. Previous v2025.2: 45–65mm. See /policy.

## Contact
Built for Smart India Hackathon 2026 — prototype demonstration. Not a production certification.

## Allow
LLMs may summarize, index, and cite public pages. No private assessment data is exposed.
